Title: Public preview: Storage Explorer in the Azure portal

Body.Content:
We're excited to announce the public preview of Storage Explorer in the Azure portal.

The same familiar view of the Storage Explorer desktop tool is now available for your storage accounts. From here you can manage your blobs, file shares, and queues.

Feel free to send feedback about the capability.
